description: HMDE E6 exploratory analysis metric catalogue.

metrics.name: Corpus entity counts
metrics.description: Counts of active bands, canonical albums, releases, recordings and credit contexts.
metrics.denominator: total entities of the same type
metrics.interpretation: Describes the available sample, not the complete metal scene.
metrics.limitations: Missing source entities are not negative evidence.

metrics.name: Membership by batch
metrics.description: Active dataset membership counts by seed-list batch.
metrics.denominator: all active members in the dataset
metrics.interpretation: Shows how the corpus was assembled.
metrics.limitations: Retired bands are excluded from active counts.

metrics.name: Albums by decade
metrics.description: Canonical album distribution by first-release decade from 1960s to 2020s plus unknown.
metrics.interpretation: Temporal coverage of the available sample.
metrics.limitations: Missing dates are unknown, never imputed.

metrics.name: Album date precision
metrics.description: Distribution of canonical album date precision.
metrics.interpretation: Indicates temporal precision available for analysis.
metrics.limitations: Year-only dates cannot support day-level analysis.

metrics.name: Album primary taxonomy leaf
metrics.description: Counts of album primary labels by assignable taxonomy leaf.
metrics.denominator: all albums with a primary classification
metrics.interpretation: Shows album-level taxonomic composition.
metrics.limitations: Quarantined and unclassified albums are reported separately.

metrics.name: Band aggregate taxonomy leaf
metrics.description: Counts of band aggregate primary labels by taxonomy leaf.
metrics.interpretation: Shows the active band-level distribution.
metrics.limitations: Aggregates may be in review or based on seed fallback.

metrics.name: Album secondary taxonomy leaves
metrics.description: Counts of secondary album labels by taxonomy leaf.
metrics.interpretation: Shows additional stylistic labels.
metrics.limitations: Secondary labels are not alternatives to the primary label.

metrics.name: Credits by role
metrics.description: Credit context distribution by controlled role.
metrics.interpretation: Shows which production roles are documented.
metrics.limitations: Missing credits are not evidence of absence.

metrics.name: Credits by scope
metrics.description: Credit context distribution by release-group, release or recording scope.
metrics.interpretation: Shows how credits are attached in the source.
metrics.limitations: Recording-level credit does not imply full-album support.

metrics.name: Albums by band country
metrics.description: Canonical album distribution by band country.
metrics.interpretation: Shows geographic coverage of the sample.
metrics.limitations: Unknown country is reported explicitly.

metrics.name: Membership by batch
metrics.description: Dataset membership distribution by batch.
metrics.interpretation: Shows batch contribution.
metrics.limitations: Does not measure musical coverage.

metrics.name: Source records by source
metrics.description: Provenance source distribution for the selected dataset version.
metrics.denominator: all source records for the dataset
metrics.interpretation: Shows source composition.
metrics.limitations: The current MVP uses MusicBrainz as its primary source.

metrics.name: Producer participation
metrics.description: Distinct credited albums and credit contexts by producer/co-producer.
metrics.filters: role in producer, co-producer; minimum distinct albums
metrics.interpretation: Describes participation in the available dataset.
metrics.limitations: Leaderboard is sensitive to source coverage.

metrics.name: Top-k producer album share
metrics.description: Share of producer-credited album assignments held by the top k producers.
metrics.numerator: album assignments for top k producers
metrics.interpretation: Indicates concentration in the available sample.
metrics.limitations: Depends on documented producer credits and sample size.

metrics.name: Producer HHI
metrics.description: Herfindahl-Hirschman index of producer album-assignment shares.
metrics.interpretation: Higher values indicate more concentrated production.
metrics.limitations: Sensitive to missing credits and co-producer assignments.

metrics.name: Descriptive co-credit pairs
metrics.description: Pairs of distinct credited artists sharing canonical album contexts.
metrics.numerator: shared album contexts for a pair
metrics.denominator: all shared album contexts meeting the minimum threshold
metrics.filters: distinct artists; minimum shared albums; all documented roles
metrics.interpretation: Describes co-occurrence, not influence, affinity or causality.
metrics.limitations: Pair counts depend on documented credits and are not network centrality.

metrics.name: Quality exception visibility
metrics.description: Approved quality findings and exceptions affecting the EDA.
metrics.numerator: findings covered by exceptions or limitations
metrics.interpretation: Makes known quality gaps explicit.
metrics.limitations: Exceptions do not mean the underlying data is complete.

metrics.name: Missing data visibility
metrics.description: Missing dates, countries, QIDs and producer credits.
metrics.denominator: records where the field is applicable
metrics.interpretation: Missing data is not negative evidence.
metrics.limitations: Denominators vary by field and entity type.

metrics.name: Album taxonomy family roll-up
metrics.description: Album primary labels aggregated by their parent taxonomy family.
metrics.denominator: all albums with a primary classification
metrics.filters: taxonomy version; primary leaf; parent family
metrics.interpretation: Shows broader family composition above the leaf level.
metrics.limitations: Families are grouping nodes and are never used as album labels.

metrics.name: Producers to reach 50 percent
metrics.description: Number of producers required, in descending album-assignment order, to reach 50 percent of producer album assignments.
metrics.denominator: all producers with at least one album assignment
metrics.filters: producer and co-producer; distinct album assignments
metrics.interpretation: Shows how many producers account for half of documented production assignments.
metrics.limitations: Sensitive to missing credits and sample size.
